name: 78956 · Schulenburg, TX
findings: ZIP 78956 (Schulenburg) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78956 (Schulenburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78956 (Schulenburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
